name: Nodestream Ltd
summary: Nodestream Ltd engages in the provision of remote communications technology based on data transmission protocols in Australia. The company offers Nodestream, a remote monitoring and operations solution; Nodestream Live, a situational awareness for remote assets product; Nodestream X for monitoring and controlling remote assets. It also develops and delivers proprietary software, products and services enabling the secure encrypted transfer of data, including video and audio via satellite or congested networks at ultra-low bandwidths; and provides SaaS-based mobile technology platform for connectivity and operational support to field technicians with user interface and integration with job and project management software to energy, maritime, offshore services, defense, utilities, security and surveillance and unmanned systems sectors. The company was formerly known as Harvest Technology Group Limited and changed its name to Nodestream Ltd in July 2026. Nodestream Ltd was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Bentley, Australia.
